notes: Fix OutOfMemoryError when attaching a screen recording. Uploads stream base64 directly into the request body instead of building one giant String (a 43 MB file became a 57M-char String = 114 MB, then kotlinx copied it again = 241 MB allocation in a 256 MB heap). Peak extra memory is now a 12 KB chunk. Client attachment cap raised to 64 MB; the host accepts 200 MB.
